article.headline: Minnesota and Milwaukee square off in non-conference matchup
article.description: Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, ninth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Minnesota and Milwaukee square off in non-conference matchup
article.linkText: Minnesota and Milwaukee square off in non-conference matchup
article.story: Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, ninth in the Western Conference) Minneapolis; Monday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Minnesota faces Milwaukee in a non-conference matchup. Minnesota finished 49-33 overall last season while going 26-15 at home. The Timberwolves averaged 18.3 points off of turnovers, 14.3 second-chance points and 35.0 bench points last season. Milwaukee finished 32-50 overall with a 13-28 record on the road last season. The Bucks averaged 110.6 points per game last season, 13.9 on free throws and 45.3 from beyond the arc. INJURIES: Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles), Rudy Gobert: out (back), Anthony Edwards: out (knee). Bucks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
